2609.10441.title: ConvMem: Convolutional Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
2609.10441.paper_summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, they often struggle with extremely long contexts due to fixed context limits. To address this, sequential approaches like MemAgent extend the effective context by reading text in segments and iteratively updating a fixed-size memory. However, this sequential paradigm suffers from high latency and requires costly reinforcement learning (RL) training, which can lead to overfitting on specific datasets. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConvMem, a training-free, highly parallelizable framework that reformulates long-context reasoning as a hierarchical convolution. Inspired by CNNs, ConvMem treats an LLM prompted with a specific query as a convolutional kernel. This kernel summarizes text segments hierarchically, shortening the reasoning path from a linear chain into a logarithmic tree. Specifically, ConvMem integrates \textit{Configurable Strides} and \textit{Skip Connections} to ensure robust evidence capture and propagation, while employing \textit{Multi-Kernel Convolution} to decompose complex queries into disentangled semantic channels. This design not only mitigates error accumulation but also enables massive parallelization across both text segments and reasoning threads. Experiments on RULER-HotpotQA and RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA demonstrate that ConvMem outperforms training-free baselines and avoids the risk of overfitting to parametric priors often observed in RL-trained models on out-of-distribution tasks.
2609.10441.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）雖然展現了令人印象深刻的能力，但由於固定的上下文限制，它們在處理極長的上下文時常常會遇到困難。為了解決這個問題，像 MemAgent 這樣的序列方法通過分段閱讀文本並迭代更新固定大小的記憶來擴展有效上下文。然而，這種序列範式存在高延遲的問題，並且需要昂貴的強化學習（RL）訓練，這可能導致在特定數據集上過擬合。為了克服這些限制，我們提出了 ConvMem，一個無需訓練且高度可並行化的框架，將長上下文推理重新構造為層次卷積。受 CNNs 啟發，ConvMem 將以特定查詢提示的 LLM 視為卷積核。這個卷積核以層次方式總結文本片段，將推理路徑從線性鏈縮短為對數樹。具體而言，ConvMem 整合了 \textit{Configurable Strides} 和 \textit{Skip Connections} 以確保穩健的證據捕獲和傳播，同時採用 \textit{Multi-Kernel Convolution} 將複雜查詢分解為解耦的語義通道。這一設計不僅減少了錯誤累積，還使得在文本片段和推理線程之間實現大規模並行化成為可能。在 RULER-HotpotQA 和 RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA 上的實驗表明，ConvMem 超越了無需訓練的基準，並避免了在分佈外任務中常見的對參數先驗的過擬合風險，這種情況通常在 RL 訓練的模型中出現。
